items.source_title: 小學堂字形演變資料庫 record for 二
items.period: Mid-Western Zhou, as identified by the Commons description for the 免簋 example
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 二 in Western Zhou bronze-script style, linked to the mid-Western Zhou 免簋 example; it shows the two-stroke numeral graph.
items.alt: Two horizontal strokes, the upper shorter than the lower, drawn in a Western Zhou bronze-script style.
items.selection_reason: The Commons page identifies this specific redraw as 二, names the 免簋 context, and links form 33.F82B on the Xiaoxuetang 二 record. It provides a sourced historical-style example relevant to the simple two-stroke graph.
items.rights: CC0 1.0, as stated for the Sinica Database picture on the Commons file page and in the Xiaoxuetang query-interface rights notice.

limitations.text: The candidate is a digitally created vector redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph. The direct SVG and Xiaoxuetang record could not be opened by the web tool, so visual inspection and independent verification against the underlying inscription were not performed.
